text:
maya: quick ping 0min ago I hit a deterministic corruption when prefill crosses 4096 on magnet24b-int8. seems reproducible with our int8 build only; fp16 looks fine.

ciara: ugh, that sounds like my rotary mul change. i added a multiplier `mul = seq_len / ROTARY_BASE` to scale rotations for >base windows when onboarding 16k.

sasha: can you drop the exact command + minimal prompt you used so we can run a matrix?

maya: command: `./inference --model magnet24b-int8 --prefill 5200 --seed 42 --device v100-32g-pool1 --warmhead=true`

maya: minimal prompt: `system: assistant. user: Here is a long doc... <~5.2k tokens filler> Please summarize.`

teo: what error symptoms? token garble, repetitions, or semantic drift? any kv warnings in logs?

maya: semantic drift + garbled tokens. KV log excerpt: ``KV_write_index=4096 -> wrapped_to=0 WARN: overlap_detected`` decoded diff: "the results were unanimous" -> "the resuls werz unu..."

ciara: looking at the change now. code is this: ```python
ROTARY_BASE = 4096
mul = seq_len // ROTARY_BASE
rotary_scale = 1.0 + (mul - 1) * 0.0005
``` -> note the integer floor division. on exact multiples mul becomes 1 (fine) but in some C++ cast paths int math -> zero if seq_len smaller? i'll repro.

sasha: pls run fp16 vs int8 across edges [4095,4096,4097,8191] and capture `kv_index.log` + `rot_phase_layer_{n}.txt`. also collect raw tokens for diffing.

maya: running matrix now on staging, will attach CSV. starting with seeds [42, 99] and both v100/a100 nodes.

ops-bot: alert: 1777881005: staging metrics: magnet24b-int8 kv-wrap_count=18 (5m window) 

teo: another angle: could the allocator zero a page when wrap race coincides with quantized memcpy? int8 memcpy might be 8-byte aligned and a race could leave partly stale data.

ciara: noted. i'm also checking the C++ rotary helper; there is a cast path `int mul = seq_len / base; float scale = 1.0f + (mul - 1) * small` that could underflow if mul computed as 0.

sasha: good call. add defensive clamps: mul = max(1, seq_len / base) and change division to float for the scaling term. add unit test for exact multiples and off-by-one.

maya: results: int8 fail at 4097 reproducible. fp16 clean. attached `diff_tokens_4097.csv` and `kv_index_4097.log`. also zips of `kv_dump_layer{0..23}.npy` for the failing run.

teo: from kv dumps, layer 18 rot_phase angles diverge ~0.0025 rad after wrap. matches rotary_scale mismatch hypothesis.

ciara: pushed a guarded hotfix to canary: `mul = std::max(1, (seq_len + base - 1) / base)` and changed to float interpolation. kicking canary.

ops-bot: info: 1777890030: canary pipeline started for canary-rotary-fix on magnet24b-int8

sasha: also add micro-smoke that primes exactly at 4095/4096/4097 on PR-merge to catch regressions.

ops-bot: info: 1777890055: canary run completed. kv-wrap_count returned to baseline, no immediate corruption observed in test corpus.

maya: verified quick checks: hotfix removed the cliff for our sample prompts. i'll run the full seed matrix overnight and file a postmortem with diffs + artifact links.

ciara: follow-ups: 1) add unit tests for multiples and multiples+1, 2) add allocator/fence asserts around kv wrap to rule out race, 3) add nightly canary for int8 edge primes.

sasha: perf-note: also run quantized memcpy stress to validate no partial-page writes.

teo: thanks all. tagging infra to keep an eye on staging KV counters for a day.

maya: thanks team 44D will attach final CSV & gifs in ticket tomorrow.
